title: cuscuta epithymum var. subulata
intro: Cuscuta epithymum var. subulata, commonly known as Dodder, is a parasitic plant that belongs to the Convolvulaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Dodder are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, among others. The bioactive constituents of Dodder may also contribute to its purported health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
